init_text_classification_pipeline: initialize a TextClassificationPipeline with a spaCy model_id from HuggingFace in namespace/model_name format
run_text_classification: run text classification on input text to get category labels and confidence scores
validate_model_id: validate that a model_id follows the namespace/model_name format required by the pipeline
install_spacy_model_wheel: install a spaCy model wheel package from HuggingFace using pip with a cache directory
extract_category_scores: extract category labels and confidence scores from a spaCy document as a list of dictionaries
